action.prompt:
Before this work is called done, run through the TELETEXT LIVES verify-before-upload checklist and report each item honestly:
1. node --check app.js passes.
2. The change was verified in the CDP harness against the local build, browser cache cleared and hard reload. Computed styles alone are not proof - check rendered sizes and pixels (the phone fastext bug hid behind correct computed styles on spans that were 0px tall).
3. Header rows are exactly 40 cells, with the live weekday and the ticking clock.
4. No new JS exceptions.
If an item was not run, say so plainly instead of implying it passed. Nothing is uploaded from a CLI session - uploads happen separately, and are followed by a check of the live site.

hooks.description: When a session ends, hold the work to this project's verify-before-upload checklist before anything is called done. Every fix in this project was verified in a real browser before it went anywhere near the live site; this hook keeps it that way.
hooks.name: verify-before-done
